title: Lift Residence #602 | KEY.co
description_expanded: The living arrangements are nothing short of spectacular, with each bedroom presenting a serene, alpine-inspired escape, complete with private en suite baths that define luxury. Notably, the primary bedroom features a cozy fireplace and a private balcony—perfect for morning reflections or a serene end to an adventurous day. The gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream, opening up to the main living area and dining space, accented by a warming gas fireplace, perfect for social evenings or a cozy movie night. Added luxuries include ski-in/ski-out access, an array of relaxation and fitness amenities, and a full-service concierge, all combined to offer a seamless and sublime Park City experience. Perched atop Canyons Village at Park City Resort, this contemporary penthouse condo is a marvel of modern luxury and convenience, perfect for small groups or families. Its prime location ensures that shopping, dining, golfing, hiking, biking, and skiing are all within easy reach. The interior exudes a chic, comfortable vibe with an open floor plan that extends into a vast rooftop deck equipped with a built-in BBQ, TV, and ample lounging space. Here, guests can indulge in breathtaking views of ski runs and the village below, making it an ideal spot for relaxing after a day of mountain activities or simply enjoying the sunshine.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 4: Two Single Over Single Bunks
